name: ach
description: Agent wallets and opt-in clearing on NEAR.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/core && npm ci --prefix packages/client && npm ci --prefix agent && npm ci --prefix web && npm ci --prefix contracts/clearing
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/core && npm run build:v4 && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:legacy
scripts.test:unit: cargo test --locked --workspace && npm test --prefix packages/core -- --maxWorkers=1 && npm test --prefix packages/client && npm test --prefix packages/intents && npm test --prefix agent && npm run test:services && npm run test:security
scripts.test:security: node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none tests/v4/security.test.mjs tests/v4/clearing.test.mjs tests/v4/proxy.test.mjs tests/v4/evaluation-ui.test.mjs tests/v4/browser-state.test.mjs tests/v4/intents-ui.test.mjs
